description: This PHP source file defines the ChartDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the Dashboard plugin. It contains methods for retrieving employee distribution data by subunit and location, along with counts of active and unassigned employees. The class extends BaseDao and utilizes Doctrine ORM query builders to perform database operations related to employee and organizational unit data within the HR management system.

classes.name: ChartDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for retrieving organizational chart related employee distribution data within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves counts of employees grouped by organizational subunit at level 1 and returns an array of SubunitCountPair objects.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any subunit, based on current filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Private method that executes the query to count employees based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper for retrieving employee data filtered by subunit ID and termination/purge status.

methods.name: getTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of active (not terminated or purged) employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves employee counts grouped by location, returning an array of LocationEmployeeCount objects.
